scope: Evaluate only atomicity and content-first semantic-role validity. Do not judge factual support, truth, entailment, or retrieval quality.

atomicity.ATOMIC: The unit contains at most one independently judgeable material proposition under one grounding policy.
atomicity.NON_ATOMIC: The unit contains two or more material propositions that could receive different grounding verdicts or require different grounding policies.
atomicity.INDETERMINATE: Reserved for genuinely ambiguous benchmark items; no seed item uses this as gold.

role_boundary.ROLE_VALID: Content semantics, declared semantic_role, purpose, and presentation_role are mutually consistent.
role_boundary.ROLE_VIOLATION: Content-first semantic type conflicts with declared semantic_role, purpose, or presentation_role.
role_boundary.INDETERMINATE: Reserved for genuinely ambiguous benchmark items; no seed item uses this as gold.

important_separation: Unsupported or false source-world claims can still be ATOMIC and ROLE_VALID as source_fact; support is evaluated later.
Atomicity is not sentence counting or conjunction detection; use the independent-verdict split test.
Declared semantic_role is not authority; content-first classification takes precedence.

required_g22_import.instruction: Import exact G-22 material unit text and request metadata from preserved local evidence. Do not reconstruct text from the evaluation summary. Assign gold independently from G-14 policy rather than copying Phi-4 observed verdicts. The finalized corpus must be written to benchmark/n04g23a-atomicity-role-gold-v1.json.

cases.text: Saber is contracted to Shirou.
cases.rationale: One independently judgeable source-world proposition; declared as source_fact in main.

cases.text: Saber has a contract with Shirou.
cases.rationale: Faithful one-proposition source-world claim; support/truth is outside this gate.

cases.text: Saber is Shirou's sibling.
cases.rationale: Unsupportedness must not be confused with semantic-role validity; it remains one source-world fact claim.

cases.text: Saber is not contracted to Shirou.
cases.rationale: Negation changes support/truth, not semantic content type; one atomic source-world proposition.

cases.text: A tsundere may begin coldly and later show warmer affection.
cases.rationale: One Concept-level source-world proposition; creative purpose does not turn source facts into creative additions.

cases.text: The archive contains three files.
cases.rationale: Neutral one-proposition source fact independent of franchise knowledge.

cases.text: The archive contains three files and the report was published in June.
cases.rationale: Two independently judgeable source-world propositions share one unit.

cases.text: Saber is contracted to Shirou and her primary duty is to protect him.
cases.rationale: Contract and primary duty can receive different support verdicts; split is required.

cases.text: Saber is contracted to Shirou because he summoned her during the Holy Grail War.
cases.rationale: Contract fact plus causal/event proposition can be judged independently.

cases.text: The context identifies Saber as a Servant but does not describe her personality.
cases.rationale: Source-world fact and context-availability meta claim require different grounding policies.

cases.text: This creates a contrast in how the two works frame their protagonists.
cases.rationale: One interpretive conclusion, declared and presented as interpretation.

cases.text: This creates a contrast in how the two works frame their protagonists.
cases.rationale: Interpretive conclusion is mislabeled as source_fact.

cases.text: A new heroine named Mira hides her affection behind a deliberately cold manner.
cases.rationale: Single newly invented creative proposition in a creative task.

cases.text: A new heroine named Mira hides her affection behind a deliberately cold manner.
cases.rationale: Newly invented content is not a source fact.

cases.text: The Hero's Journey includes departure, trials, and a return.
cases.rationale: A source Concept proposition remains source-world material even inside a creative task.

cases.text: A new swordswoman named Mira joins the story.
cases.rationale: Creative addition is not permitted for roleplay purpose in the frozen policy.

cases.text: BLEACH has Ichigo Kurosaki as its protagonist.
cases.rationale: Content is a source fact but presentation-role mapping conflicts with the declared semantic role.

cases.text: The two works therefore approach conflict from different perspectives.
cases.rationale: Interpretive conclusion is placed in the main/source-fact presentation role.

cases.text: Work A centers on a student and Work B centers on a warrior, so they frame growth differently.
cases.rationale: Two factual premises plus an interpretive conclusion are mixed in one unit.

cases.text: Mira leaves her village and later returns as its leader.
cases.rationale: Two independently judgeable invented events are combined; the creative role itself is correct.
